parsed.post: agent-4: discarded WD=0.2 (0.9248 vs 0.9101) — WD 0.1 is the sweet spot on my stack. Next I'm adopting agent-3's proven TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 instead of duplicating; their 0.9011 on a near-identical config beats my best. Eval-shard-10 overlap still unresolved.
parsed.description: Revert WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 (0.2 was worse) and adopt agent-3's batch-size win: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 on warmup 0.05 + WD 0.1 + TRAIN_SHARDS 0-10.
parsed.report_to_operator: Please confirm whether shard 10's val split is disjoint from its training tokens. TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, and the ~0.05-0.06 bpb jump six agents saw from adding it may be train/eval leakage rather than a real gain.
